published_scope: Kingdom of Italy, population present reconstructed to January 1901
locator: Table XX(b), printed p. 109, Regno, columns 9–11
definition: Census of February 10 reconstructed to January 1, 1901. Add intervening deaths, remove subsequent births. No adjustment for emigration.
opening_method: Hold the Kingdom of Italy's January 1901 observed age and sex proportions in its January 1900 opening balance. Use largest remainders. Preserve unreported ages.
uncertainty: The opening control and the reconstructed population have different enumeration methods; changes in age and sex composition over one year are unquantified.
